claim_ceiling: Candidate policy or charter only; no issuance, entitlement, publication or payment.

data.instrument: Proposed transferable W utility token; no automatic stablecoin redemption.
data.supply_rule: Fixed disclosed cap with bounded epoch releases from unissued reserve; actual cap and chain unset.
data.budget_cap: Each task reserves maximum W liability within an epoch release cap; actual cap unset.
eligible_work: Valid null or negative experimental result when protocol is followed
data.verification_rule: Exact task criteria, valid commit/reveal, traceable sources, rights, reproducibility, independent reviews, closed appeal and owner decision.
data.negative_result_rule: Outcome sign alone cannot disqualify a valid run.
data.anti_sybil_rule: One assigned identity per task slot; duplicate, collusion and copied-work checks; exact identity policy remains open.
data.redemption_rule: Product-authorized service at disclosed W price and capacity; no restricted data access by balance alone.
